newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB, Carlton, Granada up on report of link.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB, Carlton, Granada up on report of link.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting, Carlton and Granada Group Plc were indicated sharply higher on Friday on a report in the Financial Times that said the three communication concerns would announced a link up in a bid for digital service in the UK.
BSkyB shares, adding to yesterday's gains, climbed 16p to 596-1/2 by 0817 GMT.
Carlton shares surged 20-1/2p, while Granada shares added 21p to 898-1/2.
The newspaper said the group was believed to have reached an agreement with the British Broadcasting Corp to broadcast up to eight subscription channels.
It said the move complements BSkyB's decision to order one million digital satellite receivers and launch 200 channels of digital satellite television in the UK before the end of next year.
Dealers said the deal could have a huge potential for the group's long-term profitability.
"Long term, I'd say (the shares) could go higher," said one.
